columns.name: symbol
columns.note: MGI gene symbol — the xref table's join key

columns.name: gene_id
columns.note: MGI accession (the xref accession the association is anchored on)

columns.name: ensembl_gene_id
columns.note: Ensembl gene id from the gene arm's xref table

columns.name: phenotype_term_id
columns.note: the ontology term id — the item's accession (MP:…)

columns.name: phenotype_term
columns.note: the term's own name from the term authority

columns.name: evidence_code
columns.note: the source's evidence token for the association

columns.name: citation
columns.note: the source's own citation (PubMed id as the source writes it); '' when none

columns.name: allele_marker_id
columns.note: the allele/marker accession(s) the source names

columns.name: statement
columns.note: the source's own statement, quoted, short

columns.name: source
columns.note: which association source published this row

columns.name: source_release
columns.note: that source's release stamp — the item's release

columns.name: fetched_at
columns.note: when the record was first stored

description: the query shape on the door (SCHEMA.md §3): gene → phenotypes with evidence, one row per (gene, term, source) record. Every item carries its accession (the MP term id, plus both gene accessions) and its release.
